label: DRAFT - an engineer approves each item before it is relied on
title: Engineering drawing (title block, revision block, tags, lists, notes)
source: SAES-A-202 Saudi Aramco Engineering Drawings, held in the library; its title block is Saudi Aramco's, so a contractor drawing in another title block may state the same in other words

items.topic: Revision block with date, description, job number and revision
Job Order / EWO number in the title block
Drawing type, entered on the first title line
Review required box marked, for key drawings only (key drawing types per 6.13)
Design certification, key drawing review and revision validation boxes, filled in only as required (conditional, per SAEP-334 section 14)
A line scale reference just over the title block, on scale drawings only (P&ID, PFD, ILD, VOD and E1L are not scaled)
Drawing index in the title block
items.draft_reason: SAES-A-202 6.2.2 (p14) says the index is shown in the title block, but it is not stored as a requirement of the library and does not say shall (only 6.5.3.9 mentions an index); clause not verified as a requirement. DRAFT.
SAES-A-202 6.4.1 (p14) describes the format of a drawing number and 6.4.2 says it is entered in the drawing; neither is a shall that a drawing carry it. DRAFT.
SAES-A-202 6.5.1 (p15) describes the sheet number as three digits; it does not say a drawing must state it. DRAFT.
SAES-A-202 6.18 (p22) defines a unit number; no held clause requires a drawing to state it. DRAFT.

items.topic: Tag numbers of the equipment, instruments and lines shown
items.draft_reason: SAES-A-202 section 10 (p23-26) sets the FORMAT of a tag; no held clause requires a drawing to carry tags. DRAFT.
SAES-A-202 10.6.4 (p26) says line information is entered in the Line Designation Table, a separate document; no held clause requires a drawing to contain a list. DRAFT.
SAES-A-202 6.17 (p22) says where reference drawings and notes are placed, not that a drawing must have them. DRAFT.
